Hello! It's nice to meet you! My name is Jella Finley. Your art style is so cute! I'd love to request an illustration from you!

If it's possible, I'd like an illustration of my VTuber character. She's a cheerful and kind jellyfish girl. Her main motifs are bows and hydrangea flowers. She also has a teruteru bozu mascot. Jella enjoys singing and drawing, and she has a bright personality. 

If you'd like to change the clothes, please keep the buns on her head, and the crystal that is on her brooch. I'll leave the pose up to you. 

I would like to use the illustration for various VTuber activities, like social media posts and stream assets, if that's okay? If possible, I'd like to request a version with a transparent background. 

Thank you so much for your time!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xWVyawAKeOKAUoe8yI8HnracTNzHA4qj?usp=drive_link

Hello fruitsrabbit-sensei,
I really love your soft and cute artwork. May I invite you to draw an illustration of my original character?

Her name is iko, a bionic robot who looks like a little girl, with a white, pink, and blue color theme. Her keywords are “pure,” “cute,” and “天然ボケ,” and her design is inspired by mysterious realms like the sea or space, giving her a futuristic feel. Reference: https://t.hkra.xyz/iko2

I would love to see her with a curious and innocent look, as if she is seeing the world for the first time. The background and other details are up to you, please feel free to draw her in your own style.

The illustration will be used on my personal website and may also be shared on social media (non-commercial use only).

Thank you very much for considering my request!
